verdict.rationale: Grafana Cloud's Knowledge Graph continuously generates insights that flag saturation, errors, anomalies, and failures without hand-written PromQL. That delivers threshold-free surfacing of problems, but only in one Cloud-specific feature, with no evidence of configurable anomaly or outlier detection in alert rules. Missing for 10: documented anomaly/outlier detection in Grafana Alerting, detail on how detection is enabled and tuned, availability outside Grafana Cloud, independent or hands-on corroboration.
